Word-edit game: cursor (player) moves between editable glyph x slots.
ACTION3 = previous slot, ACTION4 = next slot, with wraparound (15 -> 43 on ACTION3).
ACTION1/2 change glyph letters and the counter bar only in the frame; objects have no pixels, so no object change.
Stateless; frame argument not needed.
Unconfirmed: ACTION5/6/7 effects (unobserved, treated as no-ops).
